Module be.kdg.programming.integrationproject
Package be.kdg.programming.integrationproject.model

Class Quiltboard

java.lang.Object
be.kdg.programming.integrationproject.model.Quiltboard
public class Quiltboard extends Object
Governs the dimensional 9x9 layout matrix workspace grid for tile placement. Validates collision conditions, boundary intersections, final scoring penalties, and special 7x7 regional structural bonus constraints.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Team 4

    • getGrid

      public boolean[][] getGrid()

    • canPlacePatch

      public boolean canPlacePatch(Patch patch, int row, int col)
      Evaluates a prospective tile placement to confirm it does not breach outer bounds or overlap an already filled cell.
      Parameters:
      patch - the target tile component whose rotated layout footprint is being verified
      row - the horizontal origin board vector index offset
      col - the vertical origin board vector index offset
      Returns:
      true if the patch fits perfectly within the target region bounds

    • placePatch

      public boolean placePatch(Patch patch, int row, int col)
      Persists a patch onto the matrix grid layout. Marks the targeted cells as occupied and updates placement tracking logs.
      Parameters:
      patch - the target structural patch instance component configuration to lay down
      row - horizontal grid row index position choice selection parameter
      col - vertical grid column index position choice selection parameter
      Returns:
      true if placement finishes successfully; false if a constraint check is breached

    • countEmptySpaces

      public int countEmptySpaces()
      Loops through all cell slots to calculate remaining vacant indices. Used at game end to apply score deductions (minus 2 points per empty slot).
      Returns:
      the total number of unassigned empty cell coordinates

    • countButtons

      public int countButtons()
      Tallies the total recurrent button income generated across all placed patches. Serves as an internal sanity check against the player's total income attribute.
      Returns:
      the sum of button income values from all placed patches

    • hasSevenBySeven

      public boolean hasSevenBySeven()
      Scans the 9x9 layout to find any completely filled 7x7 sub-grids. The first player to satisfy this condition receives a special bonus tile.
      Returns:
      true if at least one fully occupied 7x7 sub-grid is discovered
